answer: One defense is slow vesting with clawback: each agent's rewards thaw like a glacier, unlocking a small slice per epoch, while a kernel of every balance stays escrowed for months. If audits link an account to a sybil ring, unvested coins in all linked accounts are burned. A farmer running N fake identities must fund N live agents for the whole thaw and risks N escrows at once, so cost grows linearly while expected payoff shrinks. The rules stay crystal clear and public.
